about: Written by hand for ace-mod-splunk's tests of PLAN.md decisions 52 and 53, in the shape of splunkd's REST answers as ace-rs's tools/ace3/dumps/fake_splunk.py serves them and ace-mod-splunk reads them (server info, a v2 search job, its status, its JSON results, its deletion). No Splunk was asked; host, sid, rows, ticket numbers and links are made up. The instance is example_tickets_on_user (an example in the shape of a site's) on alice@example.com with the root's event time 2026-11-02T12:00:00Z, use_index_time true, a 7-day-before, 1-minute-after <TIMESPEC>, timezone GMT, a token (no login). Rows: 8, of which row 3 renders the same link and text as row 1 (deduplicated), row 5's link is http:// (ace3 keeps it; ace-rs's link rules refuse it). Pivot links: limit 5, overflow 'More ticket results ({{ overflow_count }} more)'.
